card.description: Yimetsu is a towering, enigmatic figure who embodies the fusion of ancient Ethiopian and Egyptian mysticism with incomprehensible, advanced technology. Standing at 2.3 meters, his frame is a blend of sinewy muscle and woven leather, reinforced with hammered bronze plates etched with celestial glyphs. Bioluminescent veins pulse along his forearms, feeding a crystalline core that hums with low-frequency resonance. His face is partially obscured by a hooded, translucent mask that houses a pair of iridescent ocular lenses, capable of scanning and projecting holographic sigils. Yimetsu carries a scepter of resonant glyphs—a slender, obsidian rod crowned with a faceted crystal that glows in sync with his pulse—and an ancient tablet of the sun, a weathered slab of basalt etched with hieroglyphs that flicker with embedded micro-LEDs. In the cinematic world, Yimetsu moves with deliberate grace, his presence a living testament to the ancient-tech ethos of grounded realism and industrial mysticism.
visual_anatomy: **Body/Form:** 2.3m tall, lean musculature, covered in woven leather and bronze plates with celestial glyphs, bioluminescent veins pulsing along limbs, exposed circuitry beneath armor.
**Face/Sensors:** Hooded translucent mask with iridescent ocular lenses, sensor arrays embedded in mask, faint glow from embedded LEDs.
**Clothing/Armor:** Hooded robe of dark leather with gold filigree, reinforced bronze pauldrons, gauntlets with etched glyphs, belt of braided copper cords, boots of hardened leather.
**Key Features:** Crystalline core in chest, bioluminescent veins, glyph-etched plates, scepter of resonant glyphs, ancient tablet of the sun, low-frequency hum emanating from core.
evolution: Phase 1 (Initial): Yimetsu in basic form, minimal tech, only bronze plates and woven leather, faint bioluminescent veins, scepter with simple obsidian tip.

Phase 2 (Advanced): Yimetsu fully integrated with crystalline core, glyphs glowing, scepter crystal resonating, tablet of the sun emitting holographic sigils, bioluminescent veins brighter, armor plates more ornate.
props: Item: Scepter of Resonant Glyphs – slender obsidian rod crowned with faceted crystal, emits low-frequency resonance and glows with embedded micro-LEDs.
Item: Ancient Tablet of the Sun – basalt slab etched with hieroglyphs, flickering with embedded micro-LEDs, projecting holographic sigils.
